slot: AI agent / MCP / Claude plugin distribution

pick.name: Anthropic Connectors Directory (+ plugin submission)
pick.what: Submit remote MCP servers (and plugins) at claude.ai/directory/manage; auto-listed as Community after automated scan
pick.why: Puts your connector inside Claude for every Claude user; anyone on a paid Claude plan can submit (you have Max)
pick.free_limits: Free to submit; needs HTTPS remote server, OAuth 2.0 if user data, tool annotations, privacy policy, reviewer test account

alts.name: Official MCP Registry
alts.what: Open registry of MCP servers (API used by clients/aggregators)
alts.why: Vendor-neutral discovery for every MCP client

candidates.name: Gumroad
candidates.verdict: Not needed: Polar covers digital goods

decision: Ship each MCP server as a remote Streamable-HTTP server with OAuth and tool annotations, submit it to Anthropic's directory, and publish it to the MCP Registry. Local servers must ship inside a Claude plugin; MCPB desktop-extension listings are deprecated.

verify.note: Confirmed verbatim: submit at claude.ai/directory/manage, any paid Claude plan, HTTPS remote, OAuth 2.0 for authenticated services, title + readOnlyHint/destructiveHint on every tool, test account, privacy/docs URLs, auto-listed as Community after the automated scan. MCPB local listings are deprecated (ship local servers in a plugin). Plugins have a separate submit page.
